item.interpretation: record offsets 179..180 are a unique big-endian item ID; high byte groups are 256x0, 256x1, 256x2, 4x3

shop.interpretation: record offset 20 begins a big-endian u16 merchandise-ID array

special.interpretation: record offset 105 is the first byte of the dense 39-byte battle metadata tail

help.interpretation: record offsets 343..346 form a 4-byte display/classification metadata word; only offset 346 was previously recognized

monster_book.interpretation: record offset 35 is a group/level byte immediately followed by dense monster statistics beginning at offset 36
